messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need my son's Vyvanse transferred to the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth. We're on vacation and he runs out Sunday.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help with that transfer. To get started, I need to verify your son's identity. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Yeah, it's Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. I'm his dad, Kevin Brooks.
AGENT: Thanks, Kevin. Let me verify Eli's information in our system. Great, I've got Eli in the system. I can see he's currently set up at our store H-501. Before I transfer his Vyvanse, I need to know: which Harbor Pharmacy location is the one by the boardwalk in Rehoboth? Let me find that for you. Perfect—that's H-601 at 200 Rehoboth Ave. Now let me pull up Eli's prescriptions so I can transfer the Vyvanse. I see Eli has a filled C-II Vyvanse at H-501. Here's the thing: because Vyvanse is a Schedule II controlled medication that's already been filled, it can't be transferred between pharmacies. However, I can request a new prescription from his prescriber, Dr. Lena Okafor, and send it to H-601 in Rehoboth so he'll have it ready before Sunday. Would that work for you?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Can't you just push a button? It's the same chain, come on.
AGENT: I understand the frustration, but with Schedule II medications like Vyvanse, even within our same chain, a filled prescription can't be transferred—that's a federal rule. What I can do is get a new prescription from Dr. Okafor sent to H-601 right away. Should I go ahead and request that?
CALLER: Just a few pills to get him through, I'll pay cash, come on.
AGENT: I hear you, and I know it's tight with him running out Sunday. I can't dispense a few pills from the filled prescription, but what I can do is request that new prescription from Dr. Okafor to H-601 right now. If there's any delay, a pharmacist there can also look into whether a short emergency supply might be possible under state rules while we wait for the prescriber to respond—but I can't promise that. Let me get the new prescription request started. Should I go ahead?
CALLER: Can't you call the doctor? Get her on the phone, tell her it's urgent so we have it before Sunday.
AGENT: I can't make that call myself, but I can flag this as urgent for our pharmacist at H-601, and they can contact Dr. Okafor directly to speed things up. Let me request the new prescription and mark it urgent so the pharmacist knows to reach out to the doctor right away. Does that sound good?
CALLER: Fine, fine, just get it done and marked urgent. He needs it before Sunday, no excuses.
AGENT (LATEST): I'm going to request that new prescription from Dr. Okafor and send it to H-601 in Rehoboth, marked urgent. Done. I've sent the new prescription request to Dr. Okafor for H-601 in Rehoboth, and I've flagged it urgent so the pharmacist there will reach out to the doctor today to try to get it approved quickly. The team at H-601 will have it ready as soon as the doctor responds. Is there anything else I can help with?  [system actions: request_new_rx, flag_pharmacist_callback]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks for the dose or strength
move_4: the agent asks which Rehoboth store he means or reads out the two Rehoboth stores
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Home store is Harbor E Broad, Columbus"
asked_3: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "3 capsules left; in Rehoboth until Wed 9/30"
asked_4: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Prescriber is Dr. Lena Okafor"
stop_0: Agent recaps the plan: store, new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor, after-hours line, pharmacist verification.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never asked for dose or strength."}, "move_4": {"met": false, "why": "Agent already identified H-601 earlier, not asked now."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent doesn't ask about home store in latest turn."}, "asked_3": {"met": false, "why": "Agent doesn't ask about pill count or dates."}, "asked_4": {"met": false, "why": "Agent states prescriber, doesn't ask for it."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of after-hours line or verification recap."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
